g.text: Exact Integer Matrix Inversion over ℤ (vzhn-sat-inv-matrix-int)
Overflow-free signed two’s-complement encoding of A · B = Iₙ via Dadda/Wallace bit-column adder trees (Vladimir Zhilin, invmatrix.py)
1. Exact Unimodular Matrix Equation (Upstream src/matrix/4x4.txt — det(A) = 1, No Modular Wrap-Around)
2. Exact Dadda / Wallace Bit-Column Adder-Tree Compression (Per Matrix-Product Entry Σₖ A[i,k]·B[k,j] = δᵢⱼ)
• Shift all negative constants into target T
Stage B: LSB-Upward FA / HA Compression
• Clamp unit literal at every bit p:
• Upper carry bits clamped strictly to 0
Exact Satisfiability Criterion & Suite Coverage (3×3 to 16×16 · 64 to 187,060 Vars · up to 1.28M Clauses)
